My worksheet includes a very large number of these data columns. In addition, I'd like to understand the logic of the formula for totaling the quantities needed for various raw parts under completed parts listed across the top of row 1 and also account for the quantities of raw parts that are shipping to other facilities listed in cells B2:K2, the total of which is easy to calculate and displayed in cell L2. from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50682/1_50682_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/50682_0_c52550c8/1_50682_output.xlsx")

# 1. INSPECT
wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["PART LIST (2)"]

start_col = 15  # Column O, specified by the instruction
first_data_row = 2

max_row = ws.max_row
max_col = ws.max_column

print("Sheet:", ws.title)
print("Dimensions:", max_row, max_col)
print("A2 target part:", ws["A2"].value)
print("Current M2:", ws["M2"].value)

# Derive the actual used last column at runtime, considering values from column O onward.
last_used_col = start_col
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=max_row, min_col=start_col, max_col=max_col):
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value is not None and cell.column > last_used_col:
            last_used_col = cell.column

# Ensure there is a quantity column to the right of each candidate part-number column.
# The formula will compare O through one-before-the-last-used-column and sum the cells shifted one column right.
if last_used_col <= start_col:
    formula = "=0"
else:
    match_start = f"${get_column_letter(start_col)}${first_data_row}"
    match_end = f"${get_column_letter(last_used_col - 1)}${max_row}"
    qty_start = f"${get_column_letter(start_col + 1)}${first_data_row}"
    qty_end = f"${get_column_letter(last_used_col)}${max_row}"
    formula = f'=SUMPRODUCT(({match_start}:{match_end}=$A2)*IFERROR({qty_start}:{qty_end}*1,0))'

# Independently recompute expected result from input values for verification.
target = ws["A2"].value
manual_total = 0
occurrences = []
if last_used_col > start_col:
    for r in range(first_data_row, max_row + 1):
        for c in range(start_col, last_used_col):
            if ws.cell(r, c).value == target:
                qty = ws.cell(r, c + 1).value
                if isinstance(qty, (int, float)):
                    manual_total += qty
                    occurrences.append((r, get_column_letter(c), qty))

print("Derived formula:", formula)
print("Matching occurrences and right-hand quantities:", occurrences)
print("Manual recomputed total:", manual_total)

# 2. SOLVE — Cell-level manipulation: modify ONLY M2.

    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:

# 3. VERIFY

ws_out = wb_out["PART LIST (2)"]

output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/50682_0_c52550c8/1_50682_output.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)

# The instruction specifies that the completed-part/raw-part data area starts at column O.
start_col = 15  # O
first_data_row = 2

# Derive the actual bottom/right edge from the workbook at runtime.
last_row = ws.max_row
last_col = ws.max_column

if last_col <= start_col:
    formula = "=0"
    manual_total = 0
else:
    # For each possible found-part cell from O onward, the required quantity is in the cell
    # immediately to its right, so the matching range ends one column before the quantity range.
    match_start = f"${get_column_letter(start_col)}${first_data_row}"
    match_end = f"${get_column_letter(last_col - 1)}${last_row}"
    qty_start = f"${get_column_letter(start_col + 1)}${first_data_row}"
    qty_end = f"${get_column_letter(last_col)}${last_row}"
    
    # SUMPRODUCT tests every cell O:one-before-last for the PN in A2, and when it matches,
    # adds the numeric value from the same-sized range shifted one column right.
    formula = f'=SUMPRODUCT(({match_start}:{match_end}=$A2)*IFERROR({qty_start}:{qty_end}*1,0))'
    
    # Independent verification computed directly from the input values.
    target = ws['A2'].value
    manual_total = 0
    occurrences = []
    for r in range(first_data_row, last_row + 1):
        for c in range(start_col, last_col):
            if ws.cell(r, c).value == target:
                qty = ws.cell(r, c + 1).value
                if isinstance(qty, (int, float)):
                    manual_total += qty
                    occurrences.append((r, get_column_letter(c), qty))

# Cell-level manipulation: write ONLY M2.
ws['M2'] = formula

# Encourage recalculation when opened by a spreadsheet application.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Verify saved result.

ws_check_formula = wb_check_formula['PART LIST (2)']

assert manual_check == manual_total
